meta.projection: delta <= 0 largest with N_phi(phi - delta on active nodes) <= the family cap; PROPOSAL only, not registered
meta.support_definition: fraction of active interface-band nodes (|parent phi| <= 2h) with |dphi| > 10 % of the band maximum

units.D1_filtered_seed11: mm; phi + a*d, max-norm-1 direction from grad03 (small support)
units.P1_upstream_lobe: mm; phi + a*d, max-norm-1 direction from grad03 (small support)
units.aspect: e (dimensionless); x scaled by (1+e), z by 1/(1+e) about the centroid (volume neutral), + = longer and thinner
units.bump_lower: mm; Gaussian normal offset on ground-facing (n_z<0) surface, centre (xc, 0), + = surface moves outward (down)
units.bump_small: mm; as bump_lower with sigma 0.05 m (compact small support; added so the support ladder is ordered by node fraction)
units.bump_upper: mm; same on the upward-facing (n_z>0) surface, + = surface moves outward (up)
units.camber: mm; z -> z - a*s^2 + c with s=(x-xc)/(L/2), c = a*mean(s^2 over solid nodes); + = nose and tail down relative to mid-chord (a = tip deflection), mean z kept
units.heave: mm; + = body moves UP (+z, away from the ground)
units.pitch: deg; + = nose DOWN (low-x end toward the ground, tail up), rotation about the y axis through the solid-node x-z centroid
units.surge: mm; + = body moves DOWNSTREAM (+x); negative control
units.thickness: mm; phi - a (D0 style uniform normal offset); + = thicker
